title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 12 August 2026 Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 11 August 2026 Showers will occur at times in Galle, Matara and Kaluthara districts. Several spells of showers may occur in Sabaragamuwa and North-western provinces and in Gampaha, Colombo, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts. Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in Uva province and in Batticaloa, Ampara, and Mullaitivu district after 2.00 p.m. The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.
